text: What should a service do when a setting is missing?
prefix: What should a service do when a setting is missing?

text: In Lesson 5, ecom and the card zone talked only through a written contract.
prefix: In Lesson 5, ecom and the card zone talked only through a written contract.

text: In Lesson 4, each product had its own database, its own keys and its own logins.
prefix: In Lesson 4, each product had its own database, its own keys and its own logins.

text: This lesson shows where every key and setting comes from, and what happens when one is missing.
prefix: This lesson shows where every key and setting comes from, and what happens when one is missing.

text: Picture a payment service with a timeout written in its settings file: thirty seconds, as a sensible default.
prefix: Picture a payment service with a timeout written in its settings file: thirty seconds, as a sensible default.

text: In production, nobody sets the real value, so thirty seconds quietly stays.
prefix: In production, nobody sets the real value, so thirty seconds quietly stays.

text: One day the card network takes forty seconds to answer.
prefix: One day the card network takes forty seconds to answer.

text: The service gives up at thirty and tells the shop the payment failed.
prefix: The service gives up at thirty and tells the shop the payment failed.

text: But the card network said yes, and the buyer's money is gone.
prefix: But the card network said yes, and the buyer's money is gone.

text: A guessed default looked safe until production.
prefix: A guessed default looked safe until production.

text: A good cook works the other way.
prefix: A good cook works the other way.

text: If an ingredient is missing, the cook stops the dish.
prefix: If an ingredient is missing, the cook stops the dish.

text: The cook never guesses a pinch.
prefix: The cook never guesses a pinch.

text: Our services are the same.
prefix: Our services are the same.

text: The rule is simple: no setting has a default value.
prefix: The rule is simple: no setting has a default value.

text: Every setting comes from one locked store, Vault: a safe for settings and secrets.
prefix: Every setting comes from one locked store, Vault: a safe for settings and secrets.

text: Three kinds of value go into it.
prefix: Three kinds of value go into it.

text: Some belong to the system itself, like which service listens where.
prefix: Some belong to the system itself, like which service listens where.

text: Some are secrets, like passwords and keys, and every one of them is generated inside Vault.
prefix: Some are secrets, like passwords and keys, and every one of them is generated inside Vault.

text: Nobody types a password into a file, and the product ships none.
prefix: Nobody types a password into a file, and the product ships none.

text: And some only this bank knows, like the card network's address and the bank's login there.
prefix: And some only this bank knows, like the card network's address and the bank's login there.

text: The operator types each of those once, into Vault.
prefix: The operator types each of those once, into Vault.

text: Before a service starts, it is handed exactly its own settings, in a private file only it can read.
prefix: Before a service starts, it is handed exactly its own settings, in a private file only it can read.

text: Its own configuration holds only the names of settings, never the values.
prefix: Its own configuration holds only the names of settings, never the values.

text: If even one value is missing, the service refuses to start.
prefix: If even one value is missing, the service refuses to start.

text: It names every missing one at once, not just the first.
prefix: It names every missing one at once, not just the first.

text: That is fail fast: stop loudly at the start, instead of failing quietly later.
prefix: That is fail fast: stop loudly at the start, instead of failing quietly later.

text: The same rule covers the bank's business decisions.
prefix: The same rule covers the bank's business decisions.

text: Rates, limits and waiting times are the bank's choices, so each is a setting the bank chooses, never a number hidden in the product.
prefix: Rates, limits and waiting times are the bank's choices, so each is a setting the bank chooses, never a number hidden in the product.

text: The card zone has its own settings too, and every one is the bank's.
prefix: The card zone has its own settings too, and every one is the bank's.

text: The bank chooses which systems may call the card zone, and which roles each caller gets.
prefix: The bank chooses which systems may call the card zone, and which roles each caller gets.

text: For each caller, the bank chooses which websites may show the card form, how long a card-entry session lives, and how many tries a buyer gets.
prefix: For each caller, the bank chooses which websites may show the card form, how long a card-entry session lives, and how many tries a buyer gets.

text: The bank chooses the fraud limits: how many attempts one card, one group of cards, one address and one shop may make within its chosen time window.
prefix: The bank chooses the fraud limits: how many attempts one card, one group of cards, one address and one shop may make within its chosen time window.

text: The bank chooses how long an unused card is kept before it is deleted, and how often the keys that lock card numbers change.
prefix: The bank chooses how long an unused card is kept before it is deleted, and how often the keys that lock card numbers change.

text: And the bank chooses when the nightly clean-up jobs run.
prefix: And the bank chooses when the nightly clean-up jobs run.

text: Now watch the product.
prefix: Now watch the product.

text: Settings have no screen, so watch how the system behaves.
prefix: Settings have no screen, so watch how the system behaves.

text: The operator installs the card zone.
prefix: The operator installs the card zone.

text: Vault holds the system's values and the generated secrets, but one caller's fraud limit has not been typed in yet.
prefix: Vault holds the system's values and the generated secrets, but one caller's fraud limit has not been typed in yet.

text: The install stops before anything runs.
prefix: The install stops before anything runs.

text: Its message names the missing value, and the caller it belongs to.
prefix: Its message names the missing value, and the caller it belongs to.

text: The operator types it in and runs the install again.
prefix: The operator types it in and runs the install again.

text: Now take one service on its own, started with nothing set at all.
prefix: Now take one service on its own, started with nothing set at all.

text: It does not start.
prefix: It does not start.

text: It prints one message: required settings are missing.
prefix: It prints one message: required settings are missing.

text: Below it comes one line for every missing setting, by name.
prefix: Below it comes one line for every missing setting, by name.

text: Nothing half-works.
prefix: Nothing half-works.

text: Nothing listens with a guessed address, a test password or a made-up timeout.
prefix: Nothing listens with a guessed address, a test password or a made-up timeout.

text: Then its settings are handed over, and the service starts.
prefix: Then its settings are handed over, and the service starts.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: A wrong guess can never reach production, so a payment never fails on a timeout nobody chose.
prefix: A wrong guess can never reach production, so a payment never fails on a timeout nobody chose.

text: A test password can never guard real money, because no password exists outside Vault.
prefix: A test password can never guard real money, because no password exists outside Vault.

text: And the bank stays in charge: every limit, window and time in the product is a value the bank chose and can see.
prefix: And the bank stays in charge: every limit, window and time in the product is a value the bank chose and can see.

text: That protects the buyer's money, and the bank's control over its own system.
prefix: That protects the buyer's money, and the bank's control over its own system.

text: Back to the cook.
prefix: Back to the cook.

text: Every ingredient on the counter, or no dish at all.
prefix: Every ingredient on the counter, or no dish at all.

text: Like the cook, the service won't guess: every value comes from Vault, or it doesn't start.
prefix: Like the cook, the service won't guess: every value comes from Vault, or it doesn't start.
